# Sauble skills

This directory ships the Sauble skill pack (v0.1.0-beta.4) for agents that read the open Agent Skills standard (Codex, Cursor via `.agents/skills`, and others).

Each folder under `skills/` is a self-contained `SKILL.md`. Install with `install/install.sh` (macOS/Linux) or `install/install.ps1` (Windows). See the repo README for per-agent steps.
